t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Oo Tsaatsɛ Mawu i yeɔ he odase kaa O bɔ mi konɛ ma le Mo nɛ ma ja Mo. Piɔ hu i ngɛ he odase yee kaa i be he wami ko; Moji he wamitsɛ, ohiafo ji mi se Mo Lɛɛ niatsɛ ji Mo Ngɛ Ose ɔ Mawu ko be hu. Moji wa yemi kɛ bualɔ ngɛ haomi mi nɛ haa wɔ wami.
